text = raw.decode("utf-8")

lines = text.split("\n")

    lines = lines[:-1]
n = len(lines)
print("SPLITLINES", n)
print("RAW_BYTES", len(raw))
print("UTF8_OK", text.encode("utf-8") == raw)

# byte offsets (utf-8)
starts = []
off = 0
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    starts.append(off)
    off += len(line.encode("utf-8")) + 1  # + newline
print("END_BYTE_AFTER_LAST_NL", off)
assert off == len(raw)

# ---------- fence scanner (mechanical; does not claim semantic truth) ----------
# Detect fence delimiter lines: optional indent, 3+ backticks, optional info string
fence_re = re.compile(r"^([ \t]*)(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$")

fence_stack = []  # (delim_char, delim_len, start_line, indent, info)
fences = []  # closed
unclosed = []
fence_line_kind = {}  # line_idx -> open/close/body

i = 0
while i < n:
    m = fence_re.match(lines[i])
    if m:
        indent, ticks, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        ch = ticks[0]
        ln = len(ticks)
        if not fence_stack:
            fence_stack.append((ch, ln, i, indent, rest.strip()))
            fence_line_kind[i] = "FENCE_OPEN"
        else:
            top = fence_stack[-1]
            # CommonMark: closing fence must be same char, >= opening length, info empty
            if ch == top[0] and ln >= top[1] and rest.strip() == "":
                start = top[2]
                fences.append({
                    "start": start + 1,  # 1-based later
                    "end": i + 1,
                    "open_line": start + 1,
                    "close_line": i + 1,
                    "tick_char": ch,
                    "tick_len": top[1],
                    "close_tick_len": ln,
                    "info": top[4],
                    "body_start": start + 2,
                    "body_end": i,  # 1-based: start+2 .. i
                })
                fence_line_kind[i] = "FENCE_CLOSE"
                fence_stack.pop()
            else:
                # inside fence, this looks like fence but isn't closer
                fence_line_kind[i] = "FENCE_BODY"
        i += 1
        continue
    if fence_stack:
        fence_line_kind[i] = "FENCE_BODY"
    i += 1

for st in fence_stack:
    unclosed.append({"open_line": st[2]+1, "tick_len": st[1], "info": st[4]})
    # mark remaining as body
    for j in range(st[2]+1, n):
        fence_line_kind.setdefault(j, "FENCE_BODY_UNCLOSED")

print("\n=== FENCES ===")
print("CLOSED_FENCE_COUNT", len(fences))
print("UNCLOSED_FENCE_COUNT", len(unclosed))
info_counts = collections.Counter((f["info"] or "<empty>") for f in fences)
print("FENCE_INFO_TOP")
for k,v in info_counts.most_common(40):
    print(f"  {v:6d}  {k!r}")
tick_len_counts = collections.Counter(f["tick_len"] for f in fences)
print("OPEN_TICK_LEN", dict(sorted(tick_len_counts.items())))
close_len = collections.Counter(f["close_tick_len"] for f in fences)
print("CLOSE_TICK_LEN", dict(sorted(close_len.items())))
# unmatched-looking backtick-only lines that are not open/close
quad_lines = [idx+1 for idx,l in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^`{4,}\s*$", l)]
print("QUAD_OR_MORE_BACKTICK_ONLY_LINES", len(quad_lines), "examples", quad_lines[:30])
triple_only = [idx+1 for idx,l in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^```\s*$", l)]
print("TRIPLE_BACKTICK_ONLY_LINES", len(triple_only))

# fence sizes
sizes = [f["end"]-f["start"]+1 for f in fences]
print("FENCE_LINE_SPAN_MIN_MAX_AVG", min(sizes) if sizes else None, max(sizes) if sizes else None, round(sum(sizes)/len(sizes),2) if sizes else None)
# largest fences
largest = sorted(fences, key=lambda f: -(f["end"]-f["start"]))[:15]
print("LARGEST_FENCES")
for f in largest:
    print(f"  L{f['open_line']}-L{f['end']} info={f['info']!r} span={f['end']-f['start']+1}")

# ---------- headings outside vs inside fences ----------
heading_re = re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})[ \t]+(.*)$")
headings_out = []
headings_in = []
for idx,l in enumerate(lines):
    m = heading_re.match(l)
    if not m:
        continue
    rec = {"line": idx+1, "level": len(m.group(1)), "text": m.group(2).rstrip(), "in_fence": idx in fence_line_kind and fence_line_kind[idx] not in ("FENCE_OPEN","FENCE_CLOSE")}
    # actually FENCE_OPEN/CLOSE aren't headings typically
    inside = fence_line_kind.get(idx) in ("FENCE_BODY", "FENCE_BODY_UNCLOSED")
    rec["in_fence_body"] = inside
    (headings_in if inside else headings_out).append(rec)

print("\n=== HEADINGS ===")
print("HEADINGS_OUTSIDE_FENCE_BODY", len(headings_out))
print("HEADINGS_INSIDE_FENCE_BODY", len(headings_in))
lvl_out = collections.Counter(h["level"] for h in headings_out)
print("HEADING_LEVELS_OUT", dict(sorted(lvl_out.items())))
lvl_in = collections.Counter(h["level"] for h in headings_in)
print("HEADING_LEVELS_IN", dict(sorted(lvl_in.items())))
print("H1_OUTSIDE_COUNT", sum(1 for h in headings_out if h["level"]==1))
print("H1_OUTSIDE_FIRST_20")
for h in [x for x in headings_out if x["level"]==1][:20]:
    print(f"  L{h['line']}: {h['text'][:120]}")
print("H1_OUTSIDE_LAST_15")
h1s = [x for x in headings_out if x["level"]==1]
for h in h1s[-15:]:
    print(f"  L{h['line']}: {h['text'][:120]}")
